const support = @import("parallel_floating");

test "rx/runtime/parallel/floating/f64/captured/length/0/negative_zero" {
    try support.check(.{ .input = .{ .left = .{ .values = &.{0x8000000000000000, 0x0000000000000001, 0x8000000000000001, 0x000fffffffffffff, 0x800fffffffffffff, 0x0010000000000000, 0x8010000000000000, 0x3fe0000000000000, 0xbfe0000000000000, 0x3ff0000000000000, 0xbff0000000000000, 0x3ff0000000000001, 0x7fefffffffffffff, 0xffefffffffffffff, 0x7ff0000000000000, 0xfff0000000000000, 0x7ff8000000000000, 0x0000000000000000}, .length = 0 }, .right = .{ .values = &.{0x0000000000000001, 0x8000000000000001, 0x000fffffffffffff, 0x800fffffffffffff, 0x0010000000000000, 0x8010000000000000, 0x3fe0000000000000, 0xbfe0000000000000, 0x3ff0000000000000, 0xbff0000000000000, 0x3ff0000000000001, 0x7fefffffffffffff, 0xffefffffffffffff, 0x7ff0000000000000, 0xfff0000000000000, 0x7ff8000000000000, 0x0000000000000000, 0x8000000000000000}, .length = 0 }, .marker = 0x8000000000000000 }, .expected = .{ .left = .{ .values = &.{0x8000000000000000, 0x0000000000000001, 0x8000000000000001, 0x000fffffffffffff, 0x800fffffffffffff, 0x0010000000000000, 0x8010000000000000, 0x3fe0000000000000, 0xbfe0000000000000, 0x3ff0000000000000, 0xbff0000000000000, 0x3ff0000000000001, 0x7fefffffffffffff, 0xffefffffffffffff, 0x7ff0000000000000, 0xfff0000000000000, 0x7ff8000000000000, 0x0000000000000000}, .length = 0 }, .right = .{ .values = &.{0x0000000000000001, 0x8000000000000001, 0x000fffffffffffff, 0x800fffffffffffff, 0x0010000000000000, 0x8010000000000000, 0x3fe0000000000000, 0xbfe0000000000000, 0x3ff0000000000000, 0xbff0000000000000, 0x3ff0000000000001, 0x7fefffffffffffff, 0xffefffffffffffff, 0x7ff0000000000000, 0xfff0000000000000, 0x7ff8000000000000, 0x0000000000000000, 0x8000000000000000}, .length = 0 }, .marker = 0x8000000000000000 }, .owned_capture = true }, .values);
}

test "rx/runtime/parallel/floating/f64/captured/length/2/nan" {
    try support.check(.{ .input = .{ .left = .{ .values = &.{0x7ff8000000000000, 0x0000000000000000, 0x8000000000000000, 0x0000000000000001, 0x8000000000000001, 0x000fffffffffffff, 0x800fffffffffffff, 0x0010000000000000, 0x8010000000000000, 0x3fe0000000000000, 0xbfe0000000000000, 0x3ff0000000000000, 0xbff0000000000000, 0x3ff0000000000001, 0x7fefffffffffffff, 0xffefffffffffffff, 0x7ff0000000000000, 0xfff0000000000000}, .length = 2 }, .right = .{ .values = &.{0x0000000000000000, 0x8000000000000000, 0x0000000000000001, 0x8000000000000001, 0x000fffffffffffff, 0x800fffffffffffff, 0x0010000000000000, 0x8010000000000000, 0x3fe0000000000000, 0xbfe0000000000000, 0x3ff0000000000000, 0xbff0000000000000, 0x3ff0000000000001, 0x7fefffffffffffff, 0xffefffffffffffff, 0x7ff0000000000000, 0xfff0000000000000, 0x7ff8000000000000}, .length = 2 }, .marker = 0x7ff8000000000000 }, .expected = .{ .left = .{ .values = &.{0x7ff8000000000000, 0x0000000000000000, 0x8000000000000000, 0x0000000000000001, 0x8000000000000001, 0x000fffffffffffff, 0x800fffffffffffff, 0x0010000000000000, 0x8010000000000000, 0x3fe0000000000000, 0xbfe0000000000000, 0x3ff0000000000000, 0xbff0000000000000, 0x3ff0000000000001, 0x7fefffffffffffff, 0xffefffffffffffff, 0x7ff0000000000000, 0xfff0000000000000}, .length = 2 }, .right = .{ .values = &.{0x0000000000000000, 0x8000000000000000, 0x0000000000000001, 0x8000000000000001, 0x000fffffffffffff, 0x800fffffffffffff, 0x0010000000000000, 0x8010000000000000, 0x3fe0000000000000, 0xbfe0000000000000, 0x3ff0000000000000, 0xbff0000000000000, 0x3ff0000000000001, 0x7fefffffffffffff, 0xffefffffffffffff, 0x7ff0000000000000, 0xfff0000000000000, 0x7ff8000000000000}, .length = 2 }, .marker = 0x7ff8000000000000 }, .owned_capture = true }, .values);
}

test "rx/runtime/parallel/floating/f64/captured/single/positive_zero/negative_zero" {
    try support.check(.{ .input = .{ .left = .{ .values = &.{0x0000000000000000}, .length = 1 }, .right = .{ .values = &.{0x8000000000000000}, .length = 1 }, .marker = 0x8000000000000000 }, .expected = .{ .left = .{ .values = &.{0x0000000000000000}, .length = 1 }, .right = .{ .values = &.{0x8000000000000000}, .length = 1 }, .marker = 0x8000000000000000 }, .owned_capture = true }, .values);
}

test "rx/runtime/parallel/floating/f64/captured/threads" {
    try support.check(.{ .input = .{ .left = .{ .values = &.{0x8000000000000000, 0x7ff8000000000000, 0x0000000000000001}, .length = 8192 }, .right = .{ .values = &.{0x7ff0000000000000, 0x8010000000000000, 0x7fefffffffffffff}, .length = 8192 }, .marker = 0x8000000000000000 }, .expected = .{ .left = .{ .values = &.{0x8000000000000000, 0x7ff8000000000000, 0x0000000000000001}, .length = 8192 }, .right = .{ .values = &.{0x7ff0000000000000, 0x8010000000000000, 0x7fefffffffffffff}, .length = 8192 }, .marker = 0x8000000000000000 }, .owned_capture = true }, .threads);
}

test "rx/runtime/parallel/floating/f64/captured/allocations" {
    try support.check(.{ .input = .{ .left = .{ .values = &.{0x8000000000000000, 0x7ff8000000000000, 0x0000000000000001}, .length = 3 }, .right = .{ .values = &.{0x7ff0000000000000, 0x8010000000000000, 0x7fefffffffffffff}, .length = 3 }, .marker = 0x8000000000000000 }, .expected = .{ .left = .{ .values = &.{0x8000000000000000, 0x7ff8000000000000, 0x0000000000000001}, .length = 3 }, .right = .{ .values = &.{0x7ff0000000000000, 0x8010000000000000, 0x7fefffffffffffff}, .length = 3 }, .marker = 0x8000000000000000 }, .owned_capture = true }, .allocations);
}
